facts: Coasts on the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Atlantic Ocean to the west
Borders Algeria to the east, with Western Sahara to the south
worth_knowing: One of only three countries, with Spain and France, to have both Atlantic and Mediterranean coastlines. Its geography runs from the Atlantic through mountains to the Sahara desert.
